A prefix of a commit hash names a build that does not exist, so the composer drops the commit entire rather than truncating it, never writes an unresolved commit, and drops the commit together with the +dirty marker when the string would exceed 32 bytes.
defects.reachability: Reached by every LAS and LAZ export.
defects.conventionalSuiteNote: Defective code present at v0.6.1; the v0.6.1 suite run exits 0.
defects.whyNotDetected: The pre-existing cases asserted the literal that was written, so they pinned the defect as the expected value.
defects.discoveryContext: Reported as a gap by the provenance-integrity suite in PR #60 and fixed in the same PR.
defects.oracleType: self-description read back through the real header parser

cases: a LAS/LAZ export names the build that produced it, in 32 bytes

defects.verificationStatus: fixed; regression cases run in the default vitest suite

defects.name: The source archive shipped release pages whose include target was excluded
defects.observed: docs-site/releases/v0.4.1.md through v0.5.9.md are each a bare @include of a RELEASE_NOTES file that .gitattributes already excludes from the archive. Fifteen pages resolved to nothing inside the archive.
defects.expected: The wrapper pages are excluded with their notes, matching the existing treatment of the alpha pages. The sidebar reads the releases directory, so it follows.
defects.consequence: Fifteen shipping pages had no content in the distributed source archive. No measured quantity is affected.
defects.reachability: Reached by every consumer of the source archive.
defects.conventionalSuiteNote: Defective code present at v0.6.1; the v0.6.1 suite run exits 0.
defects.whyNotDetected: lint-docs-site.mjs does check include integrity, but it runs in the working tree, where the notes still exist. The check and its subject were in different environments.
defects.discoveryContext: The defect the archive-portability suite in PR #63 was written to find. It runs against a real archive extracted outside the repository, and exits 2 if the target sits inside the repo or carries a .git.
defects.oracleType: archive extract contract, checked from inside the extract

cases: dangling references and doc links, run over an extracted archive via npm run benchmark:archive-portability
tests/benchmark/archivePortability.test.ts covers the suite's parsers with a negative control for each

defects.verificationStatus: fixed; the archive check runs as a script under npm run benchmark:archive-portability, wired into test:release:execute in PR #66, and its parsers are unit-covered in the default vitest suite
